entities.name: Francis Xavier Irwin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francis Xavier Irwin was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church in the United States who served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Boston in Massachusetts from 1996 to 2009.
